registry: RTPU Credential, Transcript & Academic Records Data Registry

tables.name: rtpu_students
tables.purpose: Minimal canonical student identity used by academic records; excludes SSN and government passwords.

tables.name: rtpu_programs
tables.purpose: Institution program definitions and catalog versions.

tables.name: rtpu_terms
tables.purpose: Academic term definitions.

tables.name: rtpu_courses
tables.purpose: Course catalog records and credit values.

tables.name: rtpu_program_requirements
tables.purpose: Program requirement rules by catalog version.

tables.name: rtpu_student_programs
tables.purpose: Student-program enrollment and completion state.

tables.name: rtpu_course_enrollments
tables.purpose: Course enrollment state by student and term.

tables.name: rtpu_course_results
tables.purpose: Final course outcomes, credits and quality points.

tables.name: rtpu_student_holds
tables.purpose: Registrar, academic or account holds used by clearance workflows.

tables.name: rtpu_transfer_sources
tables.purpose: Prior institutions, credentials and source-record metadata.

tables.name: rtpu_transfer_evaluations
tables.purpose: Transfer-credit evaluation header and decision state.

tables.name: rtpu_transfer_credit_items
tables.purpose: Course/credit-level transfer evaluation decisions.

tables.name: rtpu_degree_audits
tables.purpose: Program completion/degree audit snapshots.

tables.name: rtpu_degree_audit_items
tables.purpose: Requirement-level degree audit results.

tables.name: rtpu_document_templates
tables.purpose: Registered document template identities.

tables.name: rtpu_document_template_versions
tables.purpose: Immutable template versions, hashes and lifecycle state.

tables.name: rtpu_document_template_fields
tables.purpose: Placeholder/field requirements per template version.

tables.name: rtpu_document_instances
tables.purpose: Generated document instances and issuance lifecycle.

tables.name: rtpu_document_instance_values
tables.purpose: Normalized values injected into generated documents.

tables.name: rtpu_credential_awards
tables.purpose: Registrar-approved credential award records.

tables.name: rtpu_credential_registry
tables.purpose: Verification-safe credential registry and status.

tables.name: rtpu_transcripts
tables.purpose: Transcript header, revision and issuance records.

tables.name: rtpu_transcript_lines
tables.purpose: Term/course line items on a transcript revision.

tables.name: rtpu_document_requests
tables.purpose: Transcript, replacement credential and records service requests.

tables.name: rtpu_document_deliveries
tables.purpose: Delivery/dispatch evidence for issued documents.

tables.name: rtpu_verification_requests
tables.purpose: Inbound credential/enrollment/good-standing verification requests.

tables.name: rtpu_signatures
tables.purpose: Electronic signature evidence references; no raw biometric signature data.

tables.name: rtpu_approvals
tables.purpose: Human review and approval gates for issuance/high-impact record actions.

tables.name: rtpu_audit_events
tables.purpose: Append-only audit and evidence trail.

views.name: rtpu_v_student_academic_summary
views.purpose: Program, credit and GPA summary by student.

views.name: rtpu_v_graduation_clearance
views.purpose: Completion readiness with requirement and hold status.

views.name: rtpu_v_credential_verification_public
views.purpose: Minimal public verification projection without sensitive student data.
